articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a vastly expanded context window. The model demonstrates step-change improvements on graduate-level science and mathematics benchmarks, and introduces a new 'deep research' mode that can autonomously browse, synthesize, and cite sources over multi-hour tasks.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Tops Agentic Coding and Scientific Benchmarks
articles.summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini 2.5 Ultra, which achieves state-of-the-art scores on SWE-Bench Verified, GPQA Diamond, and several agentic task benchmarks. The model natively supports million-token context and introduces improved tool-use capabilities that allow it to orchestrate complex multi-step workflows with minimal human intervention.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Humanoid Workers at BMW Facilities
articles.summary: Figure AI announced that its Figure 02 humanoid robots have entered full commercial deployment at multiple BMW manufacturing plants in the US, performing bin-picking, parts transfer, and quality inspection tasks alongside human workers. The company reports the robots now operate autonomously for full 8-hour shifts with a 99.2% task completion rate, marking a milestone in real-world humanoid utility.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Demonstrates Autonomous Household Task Chaining
articles.summary: Tesla showcased its Optimus Gen 3 prototype performing sequences of unsupervised household tasks including laundry folding, dish loading, and object retrieval using end-to-end vision-language-action models. The demo, while still in controlled environments, represents a significant leap in dexterous manipulation and semantic scene understanding for general-purpose humanoid robots.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude 'Computer Use 2.0' with Full Desktop Agent Capabilities
articles.summary: Anthropic released a major update to Claude's computer-use abilities, enabling the model to reliably operate desktop applications, navigate complex GUI workflows, and complete multi-application tasks such as data migration between enterprise systems. Early enterprise customers report 60-70% reductions in repetitive back-office task time, raising both productivity hopes and workforce transition concerns.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm A14 Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced that its A14 (1.4nm-class) process node has entered high-volume manufacturing, approximately one quarter ahead of its original roadmap. The node uses gate-all-around nanosheet transistors and backside power delivery, offering a roughly 25% performance gain and 35% power reduction over N2, with initial production allocated to Apple and NVIDIA's next-generation AI accelerators.

articles.title: Microsoft and Atom Computing Demonstrate Logical Qubit Error Correction Below Threshold
articles.summary: Microsoft and Atom Computing jointly announced a demonstration of fault-tolerant quantum error correction on a neutral-atom quantum processor, achieving logical error rates below the surface-code threshold across 48 logical qubits. This result is considered a critical prerequisite for building practical, scalable quantum computers and validates Microsoft's topological hybrid approach to quantum architecture.

articles.title: Waymo Expands Fully Driverless Robotaxi Service to 10 New US Metro Areas
articles.summary: Alphabet's Waymo announced its largest single expansion, launching fully autonomous ride-hailing in ten additional US metropolitan areas including Miami, Seattle, and Dallas. The expansion is powered by the company's sixth-generation hardware suite and an updated foundation model for driving that was trained on over 50 billion miles of combined real and simulated driving data.
